records.name: Hank Threshold
records.biography_en: Hank Threshold serves with Entry Detail, a swat detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The small door ram held vertically beside body is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Hank Threshold looks decisively focused even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
